translation:
He also says: In spring and summer there is no great vomiting and purging, and in autumn and winter no great sweating. In the sweating method, in winter and the great cold of early spring, one should take the Shendan Pill, and may also rub with ointment and apply fire moxibustion.

One should not cover thickly; one should take the Six-Ingredient Qing Powder. (The Qing Powder is the one of six ingredients in Fan Wang's formula in the miscellaneous treatments.) If Cui Wenxing's Dudu Powder (the Dudu Powder is the one of four ingredients in Fan Wang's formula in the miscellaneous treatments), the Chi Powder (the Chi Powder is the one of seven ingredients in Fan Wang's formula in the miscellaneous treatments, originally from Hua Tuo), and the Xue Jian (Snow Decoction) are also good (the Xue Jian is the three ingredients of the Gujin Luyan Fang in the miscellaneous treatments).
